title: ID0481880-DC/Si-D/NO-[RVP/T5170004763] Sessions stops after a couple of seconds.
description:
Reported behavior/issue- Sessions stops after a couple of seconds. Look in the logs for today 2026-03-03. It starts to charge but after a couple of seconds it stops again. The only thing I see is that the OCPP goes offline.
Solution:  The OCPP goes offline right after we do the "Send command: StartTransaction" and as such we don't get a "Received command", it seems that R&D is already developing a fix for this in *possibly* v9, which if the OCPP goes offline in this scenario, it will still create a TransactionID and send it when it reconnects.

additional_info.subject: ID0481880-DC/Si-D/NO-[RVP/T5170004763] Sessions stops after a couple of seconds. CRM:03056001091
additional_info.body:
Hi Magnus,
I checked with the colleagues the logs again and the reason why it fails is because the StartTransaction doesn't get Received from OCPP.
The OCPP goes offline right after we do the "Send command: StartTransaction" and as such we don't get a "Received command", it seems that R&D is already developing a fix for this in *possibly* v9, which if the OCPP goes offline in this scenario, it will still create a TransactionID and send it when it reconnects.
Please let me know if this is what you needed.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
